title: Service and scope
text: The supplier provides live online training in Tekla Structures for the customer’s nominated participants. The selected courses, group sizes, durations and fees are recorded in the order schedule. The selected course programmes attached to the commercial proposal define the training scope. Courses listed as optional are excluded.

title: Training format
text: Each training day represents eight teaching hours. A two-day format concentrates on essential or agreed focused topics with minimum practice. A five-day format provides substantially more guided practice. A ten-day format combines five days of training with five days of guided work on the customer’s own pilot project, including further focused explanations where needed.

title: Dates and delivery
text: Training is delivered online using Zoom, Google Meet or another agreed service. Desired start and end dates in the order are provisional. The parties confirm the teaching schedule, time zone and connection method separately in writing. Agreement of dates does not change the fees for the purchased course duration and group size.

title: Fees and payment
text: Payment is made by bank transfer against the supplier’s pro forma invoice. The payable amount, currency, tax treatment and payment reference are stated in that document. Full payment is required before training begins. A downloaded pro forma invoice is not proof that payment has been received.

title: Preparation and customer responsibilities
text: Before the first lesson, the customer ensures that each participant has a suitable computer, a working connection and the required legally licensed software. The supplier helps with preparation in advance so paid lesson time is used for learning. The customer arranges any internal IT permissions and shared folders. Software licences are not included in the training fee.

title: Pilot project and professional decisions
text: Where pilot-project work is included, the customer supplies its own project materials and confirms that these may be used during training. The instructor helps the participants apply Tekla Structures workflows and prepare project documentation. The customer retains responsibility for engineering decisions, project checks and formal approval of the documentation.

title: Certificates and follow-up support
text: After completing the training, each participant receives a personalised electronic TopEngineer certificate with a unique number and the course duration. Participants may print their own paper copies. Brief follow-up questions that do not require substantial instructor time may be answered free of charge. More involved assistance is a separate service, with the task and hourly rate agreed before work starts.

title: Confidential materials
text: The parties use project files and business information supplied for training only for delivering and administering the agreed service, unless another use is authorised in writing. Customer project materials are not used for public promotion without the customer’s consent.

title: Changes, cancellation and rescheduling
text: Requests to change the scope, participants or schedule are discussed promptly in writing. Any change to fees, refunds or rescheduling arrangements must be agreed by both parties before it takes effect. The final cancellation and refund provisions are to be confirmed in the approved version of this agreement.

title: Final review and execution
text: This template is a draft for review. The parties must confirm the final legal terms, applicable law and dispute-resolution provisions before signature. The website does not sign this document on behalf of either party. The customer’s request to prepare documents is not acceptance of an unsigned draft agreement.
